preconditions.description: Input consists of integers n (1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5) and k (0 ≤ k ≤ 10^8)
Input contains exactly two space-separated integers

postconditions.description: Output is either -1 or a sequence of n distinct integers each between 1 and 10^9
postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' or (all(1 <= int(x) <= 10**9 for x in stdout.split()) and len(stdout.split()) == int(n) and len(set(stdout.split())) == int(n))

postconditions.description: If output is not -1, the sum of gcds of consecutive pairs in the sequence equals k, where pairs are formed by Bimokh's moves (first and second, third and fourth, etc., stopping when fewer than two elements remain)
postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() != '-1' and sum(math.gcd(int(stdout.split()[2*i]), int(stdout.split()[2*i+1])) for i in range((int(n) - 1) // 2 + 1)) == int(k)

repair_issue.instruction: The expression for Q2 is incorrect because it assumes n is even (int(n)//2). The task allows n to be odd, in which case the last element is unused (no pair is formed). The sum of gcds should only consider pairs formed by Bimokh's moves, i.e., the first n-1 elements if n is odd (since the last element is left alone).
